_comment: GIST1M NN-Descent (the only Python builder worth running at scale; the merge family runs on the C++ side via gist1m_cpp.json). Fetch GIST first: scripts/get_data.sh --gist. No base_limit -> full 1M so recall is comparable to the C++ GIST runs; pynndescent handles dim=960 in minutes (slower than SIFT). The builder sweeps query effort (epsilon) to produce a recall curve for recall_vs_qps.
